findings: Changing only BSP material slot192 to exterior concrete makes the same terrain visible. Unchanged103 is black at the matching camera. This does not prove diffuse atlas lighting works: reflections could explain the concrete visibility.

Changing only terrain9517 blend bitmap reference to the existing native color_white still renders black. This does not establish whether the native default bitmap was bound correctly, but does not support a blend-image-only fix.
Source/target/donor material root flags, postprocess flags and option values match.
All117 retained mips across13 terrain textures match selected source blocks after required signed-DXN conversion; this is cache verification, not live GPU fetch proof.

Native draw trace110 recorded zero p_lightmap_compress_constant_0 and _1 on the affected static-per-pixel terrain draws (samples301/998, index_count15678), with the expected eight-layer lightprobe and two-layer dominant textures bound.

Read-only native-code tracing identified lightprobe upload case0x82183d2c in function0x821835d0. It requires a resolved bitmap with image depth8 and loads nine scale floats at BSP offsets8+24*i into device vectors9376/9392/9408.

Candidate103 and stock Zanzibar pass the native BSP checksum, geometry mesh-count and eight-layer upload prerequisites. Candidate nonzero scale inputs remain present. Execution of this upload path and subsequent device-to-GPU propagation are not yet established.

Trace112 shows correct CPU-side scale vectors and GPU transitions from correct values to zero before terrain drawing. Trace113 observes a 16-word type-0 packet covering pixel c208..c211 at the zeroing transition.

The opaque-grate albedo material allocated c208/c209. Native four-register material uploads overwrite persistent lightmap c210/c211 with padding. Reserving c208..c215 moves these parameters to c233/c234 without changing material semantics.

Private candidate114 visibly restores ground texture and lighting in the matched native view. All1024 observed draws retain the expected scale vectors; affected static-per-pixel draw480 matches the CPU scales. Eleven native hash checks pass.
Candidate114 preserves1951 vertex buffers,453 index buffers and42 existing lens tags exactly against its101 basis. Twelve interfaces match and all13 shaders reproduce with the corrected recipe.
